method: Personally viewed all five final actual-mesh PNGs; compared with seven previously personally viewed full official source photos; reopened 2497-01-full.jpg direct underside during final review. Not a numerical photogrammetric registration or print certification.

checks.feature: Four pale-gray concrete corner columns, open lower tower

checks.feature: Four red radial I-profile steel uprights and45degree rotated upper square
checks.evidence: Top view establishes four midpoint uprights and diamond upper footprint relative to concrete square, consistent with2497-01 and2208-00 underside. No incorrect two-column simplification.

checks.feature: Red belt beams and four face X braces
checks.evidence: Oblique/front/rear show open X-braced upper zone on concrete legs, not closed walls. Concrete top is approximately half total height, consistent with full exterior source silhouette.

Three vertically stacked levels and four-per-level representation visible in final renders. Lowest source four mouths directly supported;12 total remains visual inference, explicitly stated in README. Solid approximate bell profiles accepted, not exact casting reconstruction.

Red-orange steel, pale-gray concrete, dark bells correspond to2020 photography. Plain small square base correctly declared display support, not claimed complete plaza. No source photos/textures visible.
